objective:
Implement the env-driven runtime origin + credentials layer for services/agents-ui per specs/018-native-networking-origins/ (spec.md + tasks.md). This is a CLIENT slice only; do NOT change any backend (agents-api) code. CRITICAL COMPATIBILITY RULE: the existing web deployment sets NONE of the new env vars, so when origins are unset the layer MUST preserve today's exact behavior (same-origin relative '/api/v1' URLs, standard EventSource, cookie+CSRF credentials, no Authorization header). Absolute origins and native bearer mode activate ONLY when the corresponding VITE_*_ORIGIN env is configured. Web build/tests must stay green and behavior-identical.

Implement:

1) ENV (services/agents-ui/env.d.ts): declare optional `VITE_AUTH_ORIGIN`, `VITE_AGENTS_API_ORIGIN`, `VITE_AGENTS_WS_ORIGIN` (string|undefined) on ImportMetaEnv; keep existing `VITE_AUTH_URL`.

2) CORE MODULE (services/agents-ui/src/lib/runtimeOrigins.ts): implement and export:
   - An origin parser that validates an absolute origin (scheme + host[:port]), normalizes a trailing slash, and REJECTS values containing a path/query/hash or a wrong scheme (throws a clear Error). For WS origin accept ws://|wss://; for http origins accept http://|https://.
   - `RuntimeOrigins` resolving `AuthOrigin`, `AgentsApiOrigin`, `AgentsWsOrigin` from import.meta.env. When an origin env is UNSET: AgentsApiOrigin => same-origin (produce relative '/api/v1' paths), AuthOrigin => existing VITE_AUTH_URL behavior, AgentsWsOrigin => derive from current behavior ONLY as the documented legacy fallback (keep web working) but never via window.location.host when an explicit origin is set.
   - `UrlBuilder` with methods: agentsApiBaseUrl(), authCurrentUserUrl(), sessionsEventsUrl(), chatMessageStreamUrl(id) (encode id), sessionAttachWsUrl({ attachToken?, epoch?, offset? }) composing query params and encoding values. '/api/v1' is appended ONLY here (the single source of truth).
   - `CredentialsModePolicy` with mode 'web-cookie' (default when no bearer token provider/origins) and 'native-bearer'. Expose helpers: restRequestInit(), streamRequestInit(), statusStreamStrategy() (returns 'eventsource' for cookie mode, 'fetch-sse' for bearer), and wsAttach behavior. Cookie mode => credentials:'include' + existing CSRF source, NO Authorization, NO X-User-Id. Bearer mode => Authorization: Bearer <token from provider>, no cookie credentials, NO X-User-Id; if a bearer token is required but absent, fail with a clear Error.
   - A `TokenProvider` interface (getAccessToken(): Promise<string|null> or sync) consumed by the policy; native secure storage impl is OUT OF SCOPE (left to spec 021) — just the interface + a null/web default.
   - Keep `VITE_AUTH_URL` as a temporary alias preferred-by `VITE_AUTH_ORIGIN` when both set.
   - Add doc comments stating native-bearer mode is gated until backend G2–G6 (specs/014-backend-gaps-program) validate bearer identity at the trusted edge / agents-api JWT.

3) MIGRATE callers off same-origin literals / host discovery (preserve web behavior via the unset-origin defaults):
   - src/lib/vueWebCommons.ts: auth + agents API base URLs from RuntimeOrigins/UrlBuilder; pass credentials/CSRF/Authorization from CredentialsModePolicy.
   - src/features/workspaces/services/workspaceService.ts, src/features/projects/services/projectsService.ts, src/features/repositories/services/repositoriesService.ts, and src/features/workspaces/components/OpenPrButton.vue: remove feature-owned `baseUrl: '/api/v1'`; use the common agents API base.
   - src/features/workspaces/services/sessionStatusStream.ts: build sessionsEventsUrl() from UrlBuilder; use standard EventSource in cookie mode and a bearer-capable fetch-SSE path in bearer mode (statusStreamStrategy()).
   - src/features/sessions/services/chatSessionsService.ts: build chat stream URL from UrlBuilder.chatMessageStreamUrl(id); fetch options from CredentialsModePolicy.streamRequestInit().
   - src/features/workspaces/services/sessionSocket.ts: build WS attach URL from UrlBuilder.sessionAttachWsUrl(); REMOVE the window.location.host `agents.`->`agents-ws.` rewrite; support attach-token + epoch + offset query params (do NOT put long-lived bearer tokens in the URL).
   - Search the whole services/agents-ui/src for any OTHER feature-owned `/api/v1` literal or window.location.host/hostname/protocol backend discovery and migrate them too (the static guard below will enforce completeness).

4) TESTS (vitest):
   - src/lib/__tests__/runtimeOrigins.test.ts: origin parsing (valid, trailing-slash normalize, reject path/query/hash, reject wrong scheme, missing production config falls back to same-origin), URL building (api base, auth current-user, sessions events, chat stream, WS attach, encoded ids, attach-token + epoch/offset query preservation), credential policy (web-cookie vs native-bearer for REST, chat stream, status stream strategy, WS attach; missing bearer token error; never sends X-User-Id).
   - Update src/features/workspaces/__tests__/sessionStatusStream.test.ts and src/features/workspaces/__tests__/sessionSocket.test.ts to assert configured absolute URLs (and the no-host-rewrite behavior) while keeping the default web path green.
   - Add chat stream tests under src/features/sessions/__tests__/ for cookie/bearer/missing-token/no-X-User-Id.
   - STATIC GUARD src/__tests__/nativeNetworkingStatic.test.ts: scan src/features/**/*.{ts,vue} and relevant src/lib callers; FAIL on `'/api/v1'`, backtick `/api/v1`, client-side `X-User-Id`, `window.location.host`, `window.location.hostname`, `window.location.protocol` used for backend discovery. EXCLUDE src/api/generated.ts, src/lib/runtimeOrigins.ts (intentional constants), Playwright/e2e route mocks, and test fixtures.

Constraints: pass `pnpm --filter @extratoast/agents-ui typecheck`, `lint` (eslint max-warnings 0 — antfu rules: all `import type` before value imports, external before relative within each group, function-property method signatures in interfaces, no shorthand interface methods), `test`, and `build`. Match existing code style. Do not edit .github/workflows/ci.yml or any backend service.
